allowed_implementation_freedom: Internal language types, module boundaries, algorithms, and storage are unconstrained when every cited observable distinction is preserved.
Exact diagnostic wording and ordering are unconstrained unless a cited authority explicitly requires them.
canonical_input_forms: discovered occurrences, maintained inventory, allowed roles and resolver
non_normative_behaviors: Python object types, exception classes, module layout, and incidental algorithms are not semantic authority.
Rust crate, module, and internal type layout are not semantic authority.
required_state_distinctions: a resolver-produced role in the consumer allowed set is accepted
a maintained or resolved role outside the allowed set is rejected
an inventory occurrence referencing an unknown concept is rejected
an unmatched discovered occurrence is unreviewed and fails
an unmatched maintained occurrence is stale and fails
maintained copies exceeding discovered multiplicity are rejected
canonical and noncanonical facts may resolve to consumer-owned roles
inventory comparison uses contract occurrence signatures and multiset multiplicity
